beforeImage.name: Aligned Data Centers
beforeImage.description: Aligned Data Centers develops and operates data center campuses for hyperscale, cloud, and enterprise customers. Its operating model is asset-heavy, built around powered land, build-to-suit delivery, and long-duration customer contracts for wholesale and hyperscale capacity. The company’s geographic footprint spans major U.S. data center markets, including Texas, Arizona, Illinois, and Virginia, with additional development activity in other markets. Public materials reviewed describe a large-scale campus platform focused on high-density and AI-oriented workloads, though they do not disclose revenue or employee count in the sources used here. Macquarie Asset Management-managed funds and co-invest partners were the disclosed owners in the latest transaction announcement reviewed. In October 2025, AI Infrastructure Partnership, MGX, and BlackRock’s Global Infrastructure Partners announced an agreement to acquire all equity in the company from those sellers, but public sources reviewed as of May 13, 2026 still describe that transaction as expected to close in the first half of 2026 and do not confirm completion.

afterImage.name: Aligned Data Centers
afterImage.description: Aligned Data Centers develops and operates hyperscale and build-to-suit data center campuses for cloud, AI, high-performance-computing and enterprise customers. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dallas, the platform reported 51 campuses and more than 6.4 GW of operational and planned capacity across the United States and Latin America at the July 2026 transaction closing. On July 21, 2026, an AI Infrastructure Partnership consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX completed its acquisition of 100% of Aligned at an enterprise value of approximately US$40 billion. GIP/GIM and MGX are the current joint controllers; their exact percentages and underlying fund allocations are not publicly disclosed. Macquarie Asset Management-managed funds and Mubadala were direct owners before the closing and are preserved as former owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, AIP only as the investment program and Mubadala only as an indirect parent of MGX. No later ownership transfer or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
